description: Figure 3 is a bar chart that compares the performance of different logical synthesis modules on BIRD-dev. The chart has three groups of bars, each representing a different module: DIN-SQL, TA-SQL, and DIN-SQL (zero-shot). The x-axis of the chart is labeled with three metrics: Recall, Precision, and F1 Score. The y-axis represents the percentage, ranging from 0 to 100. The DIN-SQL module has the highest F1 Score at 81.08%, followed by TA-SQL at 75.34%, and DIN-SQL (zero-shot) at 75.34%. The Precision and Recall values for each module are also provided, with DIN-SQL (zero-shot) having the highest Precision at 81.08% and the lowest Recall at 75.34%. The bars are color-coded, with DIN-SQL in blue, TA-SQL in green, and DIN-SQL (zero-shot) in gray. The chart is used to illustrate the results of different logical synthesis modules on BIRD-dev.
